# Commission Clause

Accrues commission from confirmed net Order receipts and reconciles payout reservations against confirmed results. Orders default to `/orders`, payouts to `/payouts`, the basis-points rate to `/terms/commissionBps` and ledger state to `/balance`. Attachment handling verifies the producing clause, matching prepared item, request correlation, initialized origin, active Order and named-source readiness before using its payment totals.

Order capture and reversal observations update the commission target using completed less reversed amounts and the configured rounded basis-points rate. This is a maintained obligation ledger, not an instruction to recompute authoritative balances. Payout opening reserves funds; subsequent observations reconcile confirmations, reversals or cancellation. Requests and reservations do not prove settlement.

The inherited balance ledger maintains accrued targets, reserved obligations and paid settlements. Their units follow the underlying order/payout currency; this clause defines no independent currency conversion.

Configuration references: `bindings.orders` defaults to `/orders`; `bindings.payouts` defaults to `/payouts`; `bindings.rate` defaults to `/terms/commissionBps`; `bindings.state` defaults to `/balance`.
